03-19-1390 is March 19, 1390.  
Subtract 268 days:  
1390 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
March 19 minus 268 days:  
Go back 19 days to March 1 → 268 - 19 = 249 days left.  
February 1390 has 28 days → 249 - 28 = 221 days left, now at Feb 1, 1390.  
January 1390 has 31 days → 221 - 31 = 190 days left, now at Jan 1, 1390.  
Go into 1389 (common year):  
December 1389 has 31 → 190 - 31 = 159 left, now at Dec 1, 1389.  
November 30 days → 159 - 30 = 129 left, now at Nov 1, 1389.  
October 31 → 129 - 31 = 98 left, now at Oct 1, 1389.  
September 30 → 98 - 30 = 68 left, now at Sep 1, 1389.  
August 31 → 68 - 31 = 37 left, now at Aug 1, 1389.  
July 31 → 37 - 31 = 6 left, now at Jul 1, 1389.  
June 30 → need to go into May: 6 days before July 1 is June 25 (since June has 30 days, June 25 is 6 days before July 1).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1389-06-25
